title: Structural MRI cortical reconstruction with FreeSurfer
description: Audited single-subject structural MRI workflow using FreeSurfer for cortical reconstruction, subcortical segmentation, regional cortical thickness, area and volume extraction, topology validation, and visual quality control.
notes: Audited portfolio release. The canonical reconstruction provenance, topology correction, QC orientation, portable recon-all wrapper, and retained statistics were reviewed. All seven public morphometry tables were independently regenerated exactly from the canonical FreeSurfer *.stats files. Results remain descriptive single-subject outputs; no normative, diagnostic, or group-level inference is claimed.
